feedback.end: Apples are a type of fruit that grow on trees. Apples are normally harvested during summer or autumn.
An apple orchard is a piece of land with lots of apple trees growing together.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps. Use the diagram to help you.

atoms.b: Apples are covered in a ((++skin stem leaf)), which protects the fruit. When the fruit is still a flower, it is attached to the tree by the ((++stem leaf)). Some apples have a ((leaf)) attached to the stem.
The biggest part of the inside of an apple is the ((++fruit_flesh core)). The ((core)) is in the middle of the fruit.
Within the core, you can find ((++seeds roots)) to grow a new apple tree.
